items.title: Charged EVs | VinFast introduces electric bus lineup to the US - Charged EVs
items.summary:
VinFast’s electric bus lineup features LFP battery technology. VinFast’s electric buses are designed for urban transportation and include driver assistance systems that use cameras and radar to provide real-time safety alerts.

Approximately 2,000 VinFast electric buses are currently operating in Vietnam. [...] Vietnamese EV manufacturer VinFast has announced plans to bring its electric bus models to the US market through a partnership with NexMove Certified, a joint venture of Transportation Management Services (TMS) and Zeem Solutions.

NexMove will offer the buses as a service, combining the vehicle, charging infrastructure, maintenance and operations under a single agreement.

Deliveries of certified, homologated vehicles are expected to start in 2028. [...] VinFast North America CEO Brian Finnerty said: “We are doubling down on our investment in the US and working with partners such as NexMove to help cities, transit operators and businesses accelerate the transition to sustainable mobility. This partnership advances our vision of making electric transportation more accessible while building a lasting presence for VinFast in one of the world’s most important markets.”

Source: VinFast
